images.prompt: Minimal artisanal logo mark. A dried chili pepper shape rendered as a translucent pale spectral silhouette, faintly glowing from within, softly blurred at the edges as though it is not entirely there, centered on a single flat matte charcoal-brown field with a subtle kraft-paper grain. Beneath the pepper, one line of clean small-caps letterpress type in warm pale gold. CRITICAL: the previous attempt wrongly placed a lighter tan border and an inset panel around the design. Do not do that. The one charcoal-brown colour must run all the way to all four edges of the image. Full-bleed square: the background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border, no lighter strip along any edge, no inset panel, no vignette outline. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: Chipoltergeist

Cinematic wide interior photograph of a dimly lit fast-casual burrito counter at night. Brushed matte-black steel serving line, raw reclaimed wood panels, kraft paper stacked at one end, empty stainless inserts with faint condensation. One warm tungsten spotlight falls from directly above onto the empty serving line, leaving deep shadows at both edges of the frame. Faint pale spectral vapor drifts slowly through the light beam, with a cold blue haze pooling in the shadows behind the counter. Nobody present. Anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, deep blacks, high micro-contrast, film grain. Deadpan hyperreal cinematic realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
